drivers.definition: Physical throughput, input/logistics cost, and time to a validated production process are separate mechanisms.
drivers.hypothesis: Supply expansion may reduce cost or improve availability; AI may shorten a particular research step.
drivers.counter_hypothesis: A lower laboratory cost may not survive scale-up; faster research may leave validation, approval and capital constraints unchanged.
drivers.socio_cultural_channel: Trusted halal inputs, donor provenance and certification capacity can constrain which scale-up route is usable.
drivers.double_count_or_transfer_limit: Do not reuse one scale assumption as duplicate adjustments. Separate any documented capacity change from a separately evidenced price-mediated purchase response, and record baseline mechanisms before transfer. No AI acceleration coefficient is observed in these cases.

drivers.definition: Consumer price relative to a defined conventional comparator, measured in the same unit, channel, place, date and price basis.
drivers.hypothesis: A lower relative price may increase purchase within an already eligible product market.
drivers.counter_hypothesis: Margarine’s reversal despite a price advantage cautions that low price alone does not secure durable demand.
drivers.socio_cultural_channel: Affordability interacts with household resources, trust and whether a lower-price substitute fits a valued dish.
drivers.double_count_or_transfer_limit: Historical nominal product prices and equilibrium displacement ratios are not transferable elasticities. Use the active bridge price conversion only with compatible inputs.

drivers.definition: Sensory performance for a specified product format, preparation and comparison task.
drivers.hypothesis: A product that meets sensory expectations may increase trial and repeat purchase.
drivers.counter_hypothesis: A familiar format may fail in a different cooking technique; sensory trials may not predict repeated buying at market prices.
drivers.socio_cultural_channel: Meal roles and family expectations are testable moderators, not fixed national traits.
drivers.double_count_or_transfer_limit: No controlled sensory effect or country coefficient is estimated by this history review. Do not relabel product differentiation as a measured taste effect.

drivers.definition: Preparation time, storage, handling and availability in a specified retail or foodservice use.
drivers.hypothesis: A suitable ready-made format may reduce practical costs for a particular purchasing group.
drivers.counter_hypothesis: Cold-chain, equipment or limited distribution can erase convenience gains; convenience may be secondary to price or religious eligibility.
drivers.socio_cultural_channel: Who purchases and prepares the meal, shared eating and retail access may change the mechanism.
drivers.double_count_or_transfer_limit: Keep format demand separate from distribution capacity. HP-19 and HP-20 are formulation, distribution and capacity constraints only, not measured Premade effects. The historical cases provide mechanisms to investigate, not an estimated convenience effect.

drivers.definition: Beliefs about nutrition and health, measured separately from laboratory composition, safety and clinical outcomes.
drivers.hypothesis: Perceived health advantages may influence product choice.
drivers.counter_hypothesis: Beliefs can reverse or diverge from evidence; product reformulation and public advice can change comparisons.
drivers.socio_cultural_channel: Trusted sources, ingredient familiarity and understandings of naturalness may mediate beliefs.
drivers.double_count_or_transfer_limit: No nutritional equivalence, safety benefit or clinical conclusion is inferred. Medical necessity precedents do not establish ordinary-food demand.

drivers.definition: Ability of a named product to perform the desired role in a locally specified dish and cooking method.
drivers.hypothesis: Performance in familiar dishes may support repeat purchase and substitution in that use.
drivers.counter_hypothesis: Success in a nugget or beverage does not establish performance in a whole-cut, stewed or high-heat preparation.
drivers.socio_cultural_channel: Compare within-market dishes and consumer segments; avoid assigning a single cuisine preference to an entire country.
drivers.double_count_or_transfer_limit: HP-12 is religious/species context only, not sensory or cuisine-fit evidence. Cuisine fit is the plan’s proposed shared field. Its external workstream adoption and numerical effects have not been verified.

gate.L: Food-safety market access stays separate from religious status.

shared_names_note: Exact plan names are retained. Mass-scaling has two mapped fields, yielding seven distinct shared names across six factors. Cuisine fit is the proposed added field; no external owner acceptance is asserted.
baseline_transfer_rule: Before any numerical use, identify acceptance, religious, legal, certification, price and supply mechanisms already embedded in the reference baseline; reject duplicate adjustments, and require a newly versioned owner-supported baseline when its conditioning must change. These rows are candidate causal paths, not additive weights or independent evidence counts.
